title: ZEBRONICS Thunder Neo (2026 Upgrade) Wireless Headphone, BT v6.0, True 50hrs Playback, 40mm Driver, ENC, Rapid Charge, Gaming Mode, Dual Pairing, 3 EQ Modes, AUX, Voice Assistant (Black)
bullets: LONG PLAYBACK: Enjoy up to 50hrs* of wireless entertainment on a single charge for music, gaming, and calls.
RAPID CHARGING: Get up to 10hrs of usage with just a 10-minute charge for quick and convenient power.
IMMERSIVE AUDIO: Powerful 40mm drivers deliver clear sound with enhanced bass for music, movies, and gaming.
3 EQ SOUND MODES: Switch between different EQ modes to customize audio performance based on your listening preference.
LOW LATENCY GAMING: Gaming mode reduces audio delay for a smoother and more synchronized gaming experience.
ENC CALLING: Environmental Noise Cancellation helps reduce surrounding noise for clearer voice calls and communication.
MULTIPLE CONNECTIVITY: Supports BT v6.0 and AUX connectivity for seamless wireless and wired listening options.
DUAL DEVICE PAIRING: Connect two devices simultaneously and switch between them conveniently during usage.
